title: Laser Pong (my second laser projector videogame)
summary: Brandon Thomas demos Laser Pong, a game he built on a laser projector and projected onto buildings around Atlanta. It was a weekend project.
why: Cited by HN as a fun example of a laser projector side project that later led to jobs and wealth for its author.

quote.text: I find it absolutely hilarious that you practically just grabbed a random guy to play it while you filmed.
